features.name: z_score_euclidean_distance
features.description: Euclidean distance of z-score normalized numeric features from the global training mean vector, capturing overall deviation from the population center
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single scalar summarizing how far a point is from the dataset centroid in normalized space, improving KNN neighborhood geometry

features.name: age_edu_interaction_normalized
features.description: Normalized product of z-scored age and education_num, capturing joint human capital signal relevant to income-related clustering
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes interaction between age and education in a scale-free way, helping KNN find neighbors with similar life-stage and education combinations

features.name: capital_net_log_signed
features.description: Signed log1p transformation of net capital (gain minus loss), preserving direction while compressing extreme values for distance computation
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the outsized influence of extreme capital values in distance metrics, enabling more balanced KNN neighborhood formation

features.name: hours_deviation_from_fulltime
features.description: Absolute deviation of hours_per_week from the standard 40-hour full-time work week, normalized by training std
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures distance from the modal work pattern, helping KNN identify clusters of part-time, full-time, and overtime workers

features.name: workclass_occupation_cosine_sim
features.description: Cosine-like similarity between normalized workclass and occupation values, measuring alignment between employment sector and job type
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a bounded similarity score between two categorical employment dimensions, improving KNN distance in occupational space

features.name: education_age_ratio_normalized
features.description: Ratio of education_num to age, normalized to capture relative educational attainment given life stage
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes educational efficiency relative to age, helping KNN group individuals with similar educational trajectories

features.name: capital_activity_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator of whether any capital activity (gain or loss) is present, identifying financially active individuals
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a discrete cluster split between those with and without capital market activity, improving KNN boundary definition

features.name: demographic_composite_score
features.description: Composite score combining normalized age, education, and hours_per_week into a single socioeconomic positioning metric
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates key demographic signals into a single dimension for efficient KNN distance computation in socioeconomic space

features.name: marital_relationship_alignment
features.description: Normalized absolute difference between marital_status and relationship codes, measuring consistency between these related categorical features
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures internal consistency of household status features, helping KNN identify coherent demographic clusters

features.name: fnlwgt_log_normalized
features.description: Log-normalized sampling weight, reducing the extreme skew of fnlwgt for use in distance computations
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms the highly skewed fnlwgt into a bounded normalized feature suitable for KNN distance metrics

features.name: occupational_prestige_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of occupational prestige and income potential based on occupation code, education level, and workclass combination. Higher scores indicate higher-prestige professional roles typically associated with specialized skills.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a semantically meaningful prestige dimension that groups individuals into natural socioeconomic clusters for KNN

features.name: work_life_balance_index
features.description: Semantic assessment of work intensity relative to demographic context, considering hours_per_week, age, and marital_status. Scores reflect deviation from typical work patterns for similar demographic profiles, with extreme values indicating unusual work arrangements.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures contextually unusual work patterns that may define distinct demographic clusters in KNN neighborhood space
